items.title: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
items.summary: Hot inflation data revived Fed rate-hike bets, and leveraged bulls paid the bill as nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated.

items.title: Crypto for Advisors: Wall Street is done waiting on Congress for crypto rules
Tokenization Is About Much More Than Bringing Assets Onchain
items.summary: Instant settlement, automated coupon payments and collateral that can be re-pledged in DeFi are what separate a tokenized asset from its offchain version.
